blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A Bisaya slang word has Filipinos asking the same question: what is esmiringhoy? The word went viral after a woman who took her alleged marital problems to “Raffy Tulfo in Action” used it during the show. In its October 17 episode, Evelyn accused her husband, Ronald, of abuse and infidelity.
